study.description: The same fifteen setups after round 1 showed that fees and slippage cost 0.3R to 1.4R a trade on 1- to 15-minute stops. Round 2 uses wider stops (0.8%, 1.2%, 1.5 and 2 ATR, or beyond the signal candle), 5-minute to 1-hour candles, holds of up to 8 hours, and counts trades per day across the four coins traded together. Selection is still decided on the first 60 days and judged on the last 30.

families.idea: An engulfing candle that forms at the latest swing low (for longs) or swing high (for shorts), within half an ATR of it.
families.name: Engulfing at swing level

families.idea: A hammer that holds the latest swing low, or a shooting star that holds the latest swing high.
families.name: Pin bar at swing level

families.idea: Price runs the stops below the last swing low, then closes back above it with a long lower wick (a false breakout). Mirrored for shorts.
families.name: Liquidity sweep and reclaim

families.idea: An inside bar followed by a candle at least 1.5 times its range that closes beyond it.
families.name: Small candle, then big breakout candle

strategy.name: Small candle, then big breakout candle

families.idea: A three-candle star whose middle candle sits at the latest swing low or high.
families.name: Morning or evening star at swing level

strategy.name: Morning or evening star at swing level

families.idea: After three falling closes, a candle takes out the previous low and closes above the previous high. Mirrored for shorts.
families.name: Outside-bar reversal after a move

families.idea: Multi-timeframe: a candle dips under the previous hourly candle's low and closes back above it with a long lower wick. Mirrored at the hour's high.

strategy.name: Rejection of the previous hour's high or low

strategy.name: Rejection of yesterday's high or low

families.idea: Price stretches two ATRs beyond the day's VWAP, then prints an engulfing or pin bar back towards it.
families.name: Reversal candle far from VWAP

families.idea: A candle pierces the lower Bollinger band and closes back inside it, up, with a lower wick. Mirrored at the upper band.

families.idea: With the 20 average above the 50 and price above the 8-hour trend, a dip to the 20 average ends in an engulfing or pin bar. Mirrored for shorts.

families.idea: A large falling candle, then a small one, then a strong rising candle that closes above the small one's high. Mirrored for shorts.

strategy.name: Big candle, small candle, big candle back

families.idea: In a downtrend of lower highs and lows, price closes above the last swing high (the first sign of a turn). Mirrored for shorts.
